title: CoralCraft
description: You can convert coral flowers into fans and vice versa (1:1), or craft 4 flowers into a coral block and vice visera (4:1)/(1:4). Works for all coral types.
body:
This datapack makes you able to craft fan to coral, coral to fan, and also coral block to coral and vice versa.

Ratio / recipes :
- 1 fan ► 1 coral
- 1 coral ► 1 fan

- 4 corals ► 1 coral block
- 1 coral block ► 4 corals
